note: Saaiman had not fought since his March 2024 loss to Payton Talbott, his second straight defeat after a 9-0 start. Saaiman and his coaches at Team CIT pressed pause to make changes they all agreed were necessary. This fight was his return after about a year away.

event_name: UFC Fight Night: Machado Garry vs. Prates
note: In an interview with Independent Newspapers, Saaiman confirmed he had an injury. He said fighting five times in 15 months had not let his body fully recover, which caused injuries and niggles that hurt his performance. He said: 'When I am 100% healed and healthy, I will be back in training, maybe December, maybe only next year.' He also said he would be more patient in his comeback.

Souza said that fighters who stay inactive for a long time don't do well, so he wanted to stay active. He said he had meant to fight a top contender but everyone was hurt, and he claimed Rockhold had faked his injury.
